name: Phuket
blurb: Phuket remains a popular hub for wellness retreats, beach getaways, and sports training, though online discussions highlight rising hotel prices and local protests over tourism impacts. Visitors also note seasonal safety risks like dangerous currents during low season.

positive: Great destination for wellness, fitness training, and Muay Thai
Enjoyable beach views, sunsets, and island getaways
Affordable flight options and new luxury hotel developments
negative: Local protests and friction regarding tourist behavior and visitor numbers
Rising hotel prices and concerns about the island becoming too expensive
Environmental concerns including extreme heat and dangerous beach currents

quotes.text: • Thailand: Hotspots like Phuket have seen "Save Phuket" protests by local operators demanding stricter limits on visitor stays.• Complaints cite patterns of disruptive conduct and a disregard for local laws, wearing out the welcome in hospitality-focused communities.
